title: Clinical Simulation Faculty, MEDscience Simulation Lab, Harvard Medical School
bio: "A number of my BIOS 65c-d have become volunteers at the HMS MEDscience program, where I am on staff as a teacher. My students volunteer their time to help inspire students to pursue further education, and even careers, in STEM fields." Field: Premedical Program
